title: Approve TradePilot dashboard composition
question: Three compositional comps of the Morning Briefing Packet dashboard. Pick one to build against.

options.label: Vertical briefing strata
options.thesis: Attention, then watchlist core, then quieter market context in one vertical packet.
options.viewport: Desktop home stacked as masthead, Needs attention, deep void, watchlist quotes, void, global context.
options.risk: Tall Attention block can push the personal watchlist below the fold on shorter screens.

options.label: Split attention rail
options.thesis: Needs attention stays visible in a left memo rail while the watchlist owns the main column.
options.viewport: Left attention column, right struck watchlist table, thin full-width context band beneath.
options.risk: Split layout can feel like a denser tool if the rail gets too heavy.

options.label: Watchlist-hero density
options.thesis: The personal list is the first-viewport hero; attention is a compact strip; context waits below.
options.viewport: Masthead, horizontal attention strip, large watchlist measurement grid, context barely at bottom edge.
options.risk: Quiet Attention strip may under-signal alerts for users who need the briefing cue.
